cover.title: Something fell. NASA lost the file.

lines.text: In 1965, something fell out of the sky over Pennsylvania... and the government files about it went missing.
December ninth, 1965. Just before dark, a huge fireball streaks across the sky.
People report it in at least six states and in Canada.
Then, in a tiny village called Kecksburg, Pennsylvania, people say something came down in the woods.
Some witnesses described a metal object shaped like a giant acorn... with strange writing around the base, almost like hieroglyphics.
They said soldiers sealed off the woods... and a flatbed truck hauled something away under a tarp.
The official answer? An Air Force memo said the searchers could not find anything. It was called a meteor.
Decades later, a reporter named Leslie Kean sued NASA for its records. NASA said important files had been lost.
In 2007, NASA agreed in court to search again. The mystery was never solved.
Today there's a giant acorn by the Kecksburg fire hall. It's a replica, built for the TV show Unsolved Mysteries... and the town still throws a UFO festival.
So what fell in those woods? A meteor... or a cover-up? Comment... and sleep tight, partner.
